verdicts.quote: Each attempt creates its entire roster or creates zero users. ... If the attempt ends in rejection or failure, it creates 0 users.

each rejected row has its starting line and each applicable reason. Reasons are wrong field count, missing email, invalid email, duplicate within file, existing identity subject to C-100, or refusal under the ordinary account creation policy.

Submitting an address already reserved by a viewable account in the target directory produces an existing-user conflict for that row. / If two valid email rows resolve to the same identity, the result identifies the duplicate rows.
An added role column is refused as an invalid header. The import provides no CSV field whose value specifies a role, permission, or activation state.

A signed-out caller or a signed-in caller without admin authority cannot submit an import, including by calling the submission entry point directly. / The caller must administer the destination directory to submit an import.
The first nonblank record must consist of the single decoded field `email`. ... `Email`, ` email`, `address`, `email,email`, and `email,role` cause a header diagnostic.
UTF-8 with or without one leading byte-order mark is accepted ... Inside it, commas and line breaks are literal ... LF and CRLF can delimit records in the same file.
When the ordinary path sends invitations or starts activation, a rejected or failed attempt never initiates either for its rows.
A file of 5,242,881 bytes is refused with a file-size reason. ... 10,001 countable records exceed the limit. 10,000 pass the count check.
A zero-byte file ... receives a missing-header diagnostic. A valid header followed by no data records receives a no-data diagnostic. / exactly 1 valid new address creates 1 user.

Sending the same file bytes with the same reference again ... leads to one accepted attempt ... A fresh reference carrying an already successfully imported roster is checked against current account state.
Navigating away or losing the upload response after acceptance does not itself cancel the attempt. / the submitting admin can return to their recent attempts to see the current or final outcome.
Where ordinary creation sends an invitation, requires activation, or has neither behavior, the imported account follows the same onboarding policy.
verdicts.missing: Whether invitations for up to 10,000 users go out at once or are paced/throttled, and at what rate.

verdicts.quote: an imported user has the ordinary creation path's default profile values, access level, and initial account state. ... Profile fields, passwords, and an onboarding status are deliberately unspecified
verdicts.missing: In the fallback case, whether the user is active or pending and how they first sign in without a password.

verdicts.quote: Raw contents required by a processing attempt are inaccessible to users and operators outside the upload itself and are discarded at finalization. / The original file is not available for download.
A single documented header identifies the input and excludes fields with no established contract.

an operator ... can see its reference, destination, submitting admin's account identifier, acceptance time, final time when available, status, created count when final / ceases to be available to operators 30 days after the final outcome.
verdicts.missing: A durable audit record of which accounts were created by which import, beyond the 30-day window.

verdicts.quote: An admin checking a processing attempt is offered no action to cancel that attempt. / The admin can submit a corrected or replacement file with a fresh reference.
At the 15-minute boundary, an attempt still processing reaches a failed outcome with a timeout reason and 0 created.
verdicts.missing: Whether and how progress is shown while an attempt is processing (only a 'processing' status is defined).

verdicts.quote: An authorized caller can still create an eligible user through the established single-user workflow ... An existing user's account values, access level, activation state, and credentials are unchanged by an import
If a selected filename or a malformed field contains markup or script syntax, it cannot execute in an import screen / at most 254 ASCII characters / omit email values copied from the input
verdicts.missing: Treatment of values beginning with spreadsheet formula characters (e.g. '=' is allowed in the local part) when they later surface in exports.
